# Garage Gym Reviews

> > Trusted home and garage gym equipment reviews with expert testing and analysis by fitness professionals including Cooper Mitchell, Amanda Capritto, and medical advisors.

Garage Gym Reviews provides independent, hands-on testing and reviews of home gym equipment including barbells, power racks, weight benches, functional trainers, and strength training accessories. The site features an expert panel with credentials from institutions like Missouri State University, Lindenwood University, and the American Academy of Sleep Medicine.
